answer: The mesa debit happens at intake, ridge totals the burned amount, and pigment anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm therefore pays the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 27 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
